measured.method: scripts/brand_measure.py measure, k-means in CIELAB on 1440px screenshots and the favicon, 2026-10-05

css.portrait_backdrop: linear-gradient(150deg,#c8e1fa 0%,#e3edf6 58%,#bbcee4 100%) + radial white highlight at 80% 10%, radius 32px
css.contact_section: background var(--ink) #0e2038 (renders as a navy gradient #1B334F→#142943 with overlays)

contrast.rule: the sky accent #79B9FF never carries text on white; on white it is a mark (the square, an underline, a fill); blue text on white uses #5078A0; on the navy field the accent carries text (8.0:1)

display.example: ROBIN BOS. at 181px on a 1440 page

shapes.square_dot: a 6px solid #79B9FF square (the period of BOS., the eyebrow bullet, the period of LET'S TALK.)

easing_on_site: reveal: opacity 0→1, translateY 16px→0, .65s ease; hover .2s; nothing else

style.mood: calm, premium, direct; a founder's card, not a corporate deck
style.visual_language: huge tight uppercase name, short stacked statements ending in a period, one sky-blue square as punctuation, white→pale-blue haze canvas, thin hairlines, glass pills; one deep-navy section (contact) at the end
style.imagery: one studio cut-out of Robin on a pale blue gradient backdrop; company logos small and monochrome-ish; no stock
style.whitespace: generous; content rests on hairlines and a 1280px grid
style.voice: first person, plain, confident: 'I build businesses around people, process and technology.'

effects: none beyond scroll reveals and a glass nav; no 3D, no particles, no video
